results.text: Tirzepatide's innovative applications in the management of type 2 diabetes and its future prospects in cardiovascular health. Tirzepatide, a novel GLP-1/GIP dual receptor agonist, shows significant advantages in glycemic management and weight control. By summarizing the results of the SURMOUNT and SURPASS clinical trials, we evaluate the efficacy and safety of tirzepatide in reducing blood glucose and weight.
